The main takeaway from our work is that
ITFE is a powerful framework for spatial filtering in BCIs, and that CSP and JAD CSP are optimal spatial filtering methods for two-class and multiclass paradigmas, respectively.
the CSP algorithm is a special case of ITFE and can be generalized in the context of multiclass paradigmas.
the CSP algorithm for EEG/MEG spatial filtering is closely related to information theoretic feature selection, and can be generalized in a principled way to multiclass paradigns.
